what: Author describes ChatGPT as "primary tool for content generation, idea validation, and product creation" for digital products sold on Gumroad, targeting templates for website copywriting, AI prompt bundles for content creation, and guides and planners for entrepreneurs and freelancers.
verbatim_snippet: "ChatGPT became my primary tool for content generation, idea validation, and product creation. Gumroad served as the platform for selling and delivering my digital products, chosen for its simplicity and low fees. I focused on digital products because they require minimal upfront costs and can scale well. Specifically, I targeted: Templates for website copywriting, AI prompt bundles for content creation, Simple guides and planners for entrepreneurs and freelancers."
notes: Author uses pseudonym "Z. Software Engineer." No Gumroad store link provided in article. Same page describes step-by-step process: "Create the product with ChatGPT: Using prompt engineering, I generated outlines, templates, and guides. I edited and formatted them to ensure clarity and usability." Revenue stated as $800/month; prices $7–$15.
